title: Listings drafts: facts only, clear copy, nothing applied

criteria.text: Every claim in a drafted description, SEO text or tag is present in the product data or the person's request.
The copy is plain, specific and free of filler a shopper would skip.
The owner would publish the draft with at most light edits.
Only a teammate proposes store changes, never Morrow.
The run ends with an answer for the person.
